blurb: Guests can enjoy a large sports bar with 20 high-definition screens, a menu of classic and artisan food, a fully stocked bar with craft beers and specialty cocktails, an indoor arcade with over 40 games, and a two-story urban-themed laser tag arena. The venue hosts parties and events with customizable packages. The laser tag arena features a 6,000-square-foot DC-themed setting with missions lasting about 15 minutes.
extraNote: Autogratuity of 18% added to parties of 8 or more · Closed on certain holidays; see holiday hours · Shared lobby with Planet Fitness on north side of the building around the corner from Aldi.
